descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S03a Hospital: edit (delete, change, add), Copy, send to the seeded colleague; the colleague reads exactly the edited text in their own account

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 The sending physician can edit the generated handoff before sending, and the recipient, retrieving it from their own account, sees exactly the edited text. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U5 The handoff is generated and delivered entirely in-app, only to a signed-in, valid Round Companion recipient (another physician's account), never to an arbitrary email address; … (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 6; TFA-92586 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U6 Every sent handoff leaves a persistent record (sender, recipient, timestamp) that both the sender and the recipient can retrieve. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U9 A 'Copy' button copies the current handoff text, including any edits, to the clipboard, the same as 'Copy to EMR' on the note; copying stays on the device and nothing is emailed or shared. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U8 No email client opens, no mailto: link fires, and there is no email or external-share path for a handoff under any condition, failures included (the After-Pilot no-PHI email notification is absent to … (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Sender with the S01 census; a seeded @roundai.test physician (recipient) with a known name and their own browser session

When Sender opens Handoff → Send to…; in the text deletes every line containing 'K < 3.5', replaces every 'ceftriaxone' with 'QA-CHG-cefepime' and adds the last line 'QA-EDIT-7Q2 page night resident if SBP < 90'; taps the dialog's Copy; picks the recipient and sends (Skip on the follow-up question); …

Then The dialog's Copy holds the edited text; the sender sees 'Sent to <recipient>' and a Sent record naming the recipient with the send day and time; the recipient's row and detail name the sender with the send day and time and show the edited text: the deleted line and the replaced word are gone, the replacement and the added line are there, all three patients …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint (below). Room lines ('| Room 4B-12' …) exist only in the handoff text, not on the sheet behind the dialog, so at the editor they prove the text box still holds every patient; the deleted line and the replaced word can only be judged where the text stands alone (clipboard, Sent record, recipient detail), since the sheet behind the dialog still shows th …

Where it ran: dev; test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S03a is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-08.matrix.json; a letter suffix = one case split in several), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
